description: This file implements an immutable class DeleteFeaturesLiveCommandImpl that extends an abstract class for modifying live commands related to deleting features in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It provides methods for creating instances from commands, setting headers, and fetching command categories.

classes.name: DeleteFeaturesLiveCommandImpl
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the DeleteFeaturesLiveCommand, responsible for executing delete features commands in the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new DeleteFeaturesLiveCommandImpl instance from a generic Command object, casting it to DeleteFeatures.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, which is DELETE.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated DittoHeaders.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Indicates whether the command changes authorization; returns false.

methods.name: answer
methods.description: Provides a builder for the command's answer.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.
